name: House Wren
facts: House Wrens are tiny but intense songsters, often singing from fence posts, shrubs, or nest boxes with remarkable energy.
They prefer cavities and nooks, and may claim several spots in a yard before settling on one nest.
Their diet is mostly insects and spiders, making them busy, quick-moving foragers among gardens and brush piles.
